atlas.debug_content_hint: Also show unmapped content as its raw 0x value (for identifying new content).
atlas.max_hops_hint: Maximum path length in maps to clear.
atlas.node_background_color_hint: Node background color. The path automatically uses the more colorful of the text and background colors.
atlas.node_text_color_hint: Node-text color. The path automatically uses the more colorful of the text and background colors.
atlas.planner_filter_hint: filter by desired rewards (any match shows the path)…
atlas.ritual_planner_toggle_hint: Lists and highlights Ritual routes and their predicted rewards while line mode is active.
atlas.ritual_predict_mods_hint: Predicts the deterministic Rite modifiers for eligible Ritual-line routes.
atlas.ritual_weights_hint: Planner routes are sorted by the sum of these weights over the route's predicted rewards, highest first. 0 = neutral; negative pushes a route down the list.
atlas.search_map_hint: You can search multiple maps at once using a comma separator ','
atlas.ships_in_fog_hint: Marks Uncharted Waters ships that the game is not currently rendering.
atlas.show_content_hint: Draw the node's content under each map label, using the known names.
atlas.show_map_counts_hint: Draw connected-node and badge counts under each map label on the Atlas.
atlas.uncharted_leylines_hint: Highlights the atlas nodes and connections revealed by the hovered Uncharted Waters ship.
